apps.name: BrewLog
apps.subtitle: Pour-over brewing companion
apps.localizedDescription: Live BOOKOO scale guidance, a brew journal and taste-based tips for your next cup.

versions.localizedDescription:
iOS
• Espresso Brew tab reorganised: machine and scale on top, then beans, then the recipe with the grind
• Choose recipe lists the machine's profiles first and asks before sending a BrewLog recipe to the machine
• Milk drinks: milk amount in the recipe and a "Milk drink" switch on the Brew tab
• After a milk drink's shot the machine switches to steam and BrewLog weighs the milk with you
• After an espresso without milk BrewLog only asks about switching off (Settings → After an espresso)
• The power button shows the machine's state: Off (grey), Starting/Heating (orange), On (green)
• Smart plug: says when a shortcut doesn't exist, and Test buttons for both shortcuts in Settings

Android
• No app changes (2.7.0 was the journal filters again: a re-run of a release counted up; re-runs now keep their version)

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• Journal filters: Filter or Espresso, To review, one bean, one recipe

Android
• Journal filters: Filter or Espresso, To review, one bean, one recipe

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• The machine card's power button switches the machine on when it's offline (smart plug), and says On or Off

Android
• No changes in this release

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• After the shot: one question, Steam / Switch off / Later (or set it in Settings → After the shot)
• Smart plug through two shortcuts: the plug goes off a while after the machine goes to standby, with Cancel
• Power button on the machine card: switch off, or switch on and get told when the machine is hot
• Auto-off after 15, 30 or 60 minutes without a shot
• Asks once whether to switch off when you go back from steam to brew
• HomeKit test removed (SideStore installs can't use HomeKit)

Android
• No changes in this release

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• HomeKit test (temporary): Settings → Espresso machine → HomeKit test checks whether BrewLog can switch your smart plug

Android
• No changes in this release

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• The pressure graph's numbers no longer overlap in a short graph

Android
• The pressure graph's numbers no longer overlap in a short graph

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• Ask Claude (AI) is hidden for now while the AI connection is reworked

Android
• Ask Claude (AI) is hidden for now while the AI connection is reworked

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• A Tare button wherever the scale's weight is shown: on the Brew tab (scale card and scale tile), in the scale sheet (also with the demo scale) and on the brew screen before the pour: while rinsing, weighing the beans, preparing and waiting for the pour

Android
• A Tare button wherever the scale's weight is shown: on the Brew tab (scale card and scale tile), in the scale sheet (also with the demo scale) and on the brew screen before the pour: while rinsing, weighing the beans, preparing and waiting for the pour

Web
• No changes in this release

iOS
• No changes in this release

Android
• The selected recipe is always shown at the top of the Brew screen; tap it to change the recipe
• Choosing a recipe for another brewer (e.g. a V60 recipe while the Switch is selected) selects that brewer
• Espresso: with the scale connected to the app, BrewLog stops the shot on the machine (GaggiMate, Decent) at the target yield in every phase of the profile, and asks again if the pump keeps running
• After a shot BrewLog offers to switch GaggiMate to steam; Settings → After the shot: Ask, Switch to steam or Off
• Pressure view: with a pressure sensor a big colour-coded pressure number and a pressure graph with a target band; with the machine's own pressure weight and pressure side by side (Settings → Live shot: Automatic, Always, Off)
• Landscape full-screen chart with a button or by turning the phone (can be turned off in Settings)
• Bigger, coloured flow (g/s) readout, and the live charts always fit on the screen

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your Bluetooth coffee scale to read the weight live while you brew.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: BrewLog uses the camera to photograph your coffee bag and read the details from its label. The photo stays on this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your espresso machine (GaggiMate) in your Wi-Fi to record pressure and temperature and to start shots.
